messages.author: 927da0ea6dff5b43
messages.subject: Suppressing only some labels...
parts:
• Say I have a data frame with a field named "Method" that has 4 factors, A, B, C, D.
  • I am using the geom_point() function, I discriminate the data points by aes(color = "Method")
  • I want to attach x-axis labels but only to the data points associated with Method = "A"
New to ggplot2, Appreciate any assistance.

Thanks,

Steve

messages.author: bfc2eb6b71169017
messages.subject: Re: Suppressing only some labels...
parts:
I would subset the data frame, drop unused factor levels using `droplevels()` and plot that.

HTH,
Roman
